observations: Predicted apple first when sorting apple,Banana,Zebra by stored character numbers; code values were hidden before lock.
Revealed Z90,a97,B66,then sorted Banana,Zebra,apple. Ignore-case toggle changed order to apple,Banana,Zebra and retained original order below.
Reveal recalled both orders, explained uppercase/lowercase English-letter code ranges and offset32, and suggested language-aware sorting for people.

Inline 1280x720 light screenshot: complete readable cards, original-order history and prose. Ignore-case cards retain original codes, while button still says Sorted by code. Accessibility modes not audited.
